tools.name: teamdeck_get_organization
tools.description: Return the Teamdeck organization: name, work week and settings. Also a cheap check that the key works.

tools.name: teamdeck_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the organization. Filter by name or archived state.

tools.name: teamdeck_list_resources
tools.description: List resources (people) in the organization. By default only active resources return.

tools.name: teamdeck_list_bookings
tools.description: List planned work (bookings): who is booked on which project, for how many minutes, between which dates. Use `date` for bookings that cover one day.

tools.name: teamdeck_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time (time entries): who worked on which project, minutes, dates and approval status.

tools.name: teamdeck_get_time_entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by id.

tools.name: teamdeck_list_vacations
tools.description: List leave (vacations and time off) with dates and status (0 requested, 1 accepted, 2 requested to be removed).

tools.name: teamdeck_list_milestones
tools.description: List project milestones, optionally for one project or a date range.

tools.name: teamdeck_create_booking
tools.description: WRITE: plan work for a resource on a project between two dates. Needs a read + write key. Each call creates a new booking; do not repeat a call that succeeded. Set `minutes` (per day).

tools.name: teamdeck_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: log worked time for a resource on a project. Needs a read + write key. Each call creates a new time entry; do not repeat a call that succeeded.

tools.name: teamdeck_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project. Needs a read + write key. Each call creates a new project.
